job_text:
Frontend Engineering Intern - Brightwave Labs

About the role
Join our web team for a 12-week summer internship and ship features used by thousands of students. You will pair with senior engineers and own small projects end to end.

Requirements
- Comfortable building user interfaces with React
- Able to write clean, readable JavaScript
- Experience using Git for version control
- Strong communication skills when working on a team

Nice to have
- Experience with TypeScript
- Familiarity with testing tools like Jest
- Some exposure to accessibility best practices

Benefits
- Paid internship with a monthly housing stipend
- Mentorship from senior engineers
